items.source: Converts the provided value in a Array instance.
items.translation: 将提供的值转换为Array实例。

items.source: An implementation used in places where a proper JdbcTypeFactory can not be provided but an instance needs to be provided anyway, mostly for providing backward compatibility. Calling it will result in an exception. The features normally supported by a JdbcTypeFactory will not work.
items.translation: 在无法提供合适的JdbcTypeFactory但仍需提供其实例的场合所使用的实现，主要用于提供向后兼容性。调用它将导致异常。JdbcTypeFactory 通常支持的功能将无法正常工作。

items.source: Allows the creation of instances of database dependent types, e.g. Array.
items.translation: 允许创建数据库依赖类型的实例，例如 Array。

items.source: An implementation used in places where a proper JdbcTypeFactory can not be provided but an instance needs to be provided anyway, mostly for providing backward compatibility.
items.translation: 一种在无法提供适当的JdbcTypeFactory但仍需提供其实例的场景中使用的实现，主要用于提供向后兼容性。

items.source: an Array. Guaranteed to be not null.
items.translation: 一个Array。保证不为 null。

items.source: value - the value to be converted. Must not be null.
items.translation: value - 要转换的值。不能为 null。
